name: PvP Essentials — Crosshair, Visible Ores, Sword & Low Fire
summary: All-in-one PvP pack: better crosshair, visible ores, short sword, low fire and clear pumpkin. One download, everything you need.
description:
**One pack, everything you need for PvP.** Combines our three most-downloaded packs into a single flagship, plus two quality-of-life tweaks.

### What's inside
- 🎯 **Better crosshair** — clean, high-visibility dot crosshair
- ⛏️ **Visible ores** — every ore and ancient debris stands out, even through shaders
- ⚔️ **Short sword** — smaller, cleaner swords for better PvP visibility
- 🔥 **Low fire** — reduced fire overlay so it never blocks your view
- 🎃 **Clear pumpkin** — no more pumpkin blur when you wear one

### ⚠️ Original packs — get the latest bug-free versions here
This flagship is a **convenience bundle**. Each feature comes from a dedicated **original pack** that is updated and bug-fixed **first**. For the most reliable, up-to-date version of a specific feature, download the original:

| Feature | Original pack | CurseForge (source of truth) |
|---|---|---|
| 🎯 Crosshair | [Dot Crosshair](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/dot-crosshair-cossx-better-crosshair) | [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/dot-crosshair-cossx-better-crosshair) |
| ⛏️ Visible ores | [Visible Ores](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/visible-ores-all-versions-and-netherite) | [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/visible-ores-all-versions-and-netherite) |
| ⚔️ Short sword | [Short Sword](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/pvp-sword-little-sword-all-versions) | [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/pvp-sword-little-sword-all-versions) |

> 💡 If a feature stops working after a Minecraft update, the fix lands in the **original pack first** — always check there.
changelog: v1.0.5: low fire fixed (flame lowered with full animation, GUI included); crosshair dot at modern + legacy paths; visible ores; short swords; clear pumpkin.
